title: Steiner symmetrization preserves Lebesgue measure (Cavalieri)
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, j ∈ Fin d and let A ⊆ ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) be compact. Let A^j_y := {t ∈ ℝ : y[j↦t] ∈ A}, where y[j↦t] is y with its j-th coordinate replaced by t (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t)), and S_j(A) := {y ∈ ℝ^d : A^j_y ≠ ∅ and |y_j| ≤ (L¹(A^j_y)).toReal/2}. If S_j(A) is measurable, then L^d(S_j(A)) = L^d(A), where L^d is the volume (Lebesgue measure) of EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d).
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → MeasurableSet {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2} → volume {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2} = volume A
